title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
summary: Splice two sorted linked lists into one sorted list, reusing their nodes.

tests.explain: Taking the smaller head each time alternates between the two lists.
One list is empty: the answer is the other list.
Ties can be taken from either list; the values come out as 1, 1, 1, 2, 3.

hints: Compare the two heads. The smaller one must come first in the merged list. Then the problem repeats on what is left.
Start from a dummy node and keep a tail pointer. Attach the smaller head to tail.next, advance that list, and advance tail.
When one list runs out, attach the rest of the other in one step: it is already sorted. Return dummy.next.

complexity.time: O(n + m): each node is attached once
complexity.space: O(1): only pointers change (no new nodes besides the dummy)
